title: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations
abstract: arXiv:2608.29434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: JEPA world models make latent-space planning a practical route to control, but they are built almost exclusively on images. Whether latent prediction survives geometric observations is unclear: point clouds are sparse, unordered, and self-occluded, and with 0.3-15% of scene points moving, the slow-feature optimum of latent prediction compounds with the geometric shortcut of 3D self-supervision. We lift three canonical JEPA designs to point clouds, frozen-encoder, distribution-prior, and action-sensitive, and re-sense the stable-worldmodel benchmark so that only the observation differs from the image baselines. All three plan without collapse: the distribution-prior model is statistically equivalent to its re-evaluated image counterpart on every benchmark, and the action-sensitive model attains the strongest result in our controlled comparison where the most geometry moves. translated_title: 潜在规划能否在点云中存活？面向几何观测的动作条件化JEPA世界模型
translated_abstract: JEPA世界模型使潜空间规划成为实现控制的一条实用途径，但它们几乎完全建立在图像之上。潜在预测能否在几何观测中存活尚不明确：点云稀疏、无序且存在自遮挡，当场景中仅有0.3-15%的点发生移动时，潜在预测的慢特征最优性与3D自监督的几何捷径会相互叠加。我们将三种经典的JEPA设计——冻结编码器、分布先验和动作敏感——提升到点云上，并重新感知稳定世界模型基准，使得观测方式成为与图像基线之间唯一的差异。三种模型均能在不发生表征坍塌的情况下进行规划：分布先验模型在所有基准上与其重新评估后的图像对应模型统计等效，而动作敏感模型在几何移动最多的受控比较中取得了最强结果。探测实验解释了原因：物体位置几乎可以被完美地线性解码。
tldr: 该论文证明JEPA世界模型的潜空间规划可以从图像成功扩展到点云等几何观测——三种经典JEPA设计在点云上均能无坍塌地规划，其中动作敏感模型在几何变化最大的场景中表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that latent-space planning with JEPA world models extends from images to geometric point cloud observations—all three canonical JEPA designs plan without collapse on point clouds, with the action-sensitive model achieving the strongest results where the most geometry moves.
